text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Switzerland autonomously introduced, and incorporated into national law through the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade, the \"Cassis de Dijon principle\", which was developed by the European Court of Justice.", "severity": 0.6, "before": "«Cassis de Dijon principle»"}, {"side": "en", "quote": "Exceptions to the principle are only possible when overriding public interests are at stake.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Exceptions to the principle are only possible when overriding public interests are at stake."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "THG", "severity": 0.2, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Diesem Prinzip gemäss können Produkte, die den technischen Vorschriften der EU oder eines Mitgliedstaates der EU oder des EWR entsprechen und dort rechtmässig in Verkehr sind, grundsätzlich auch in der Schweiz ohne vorgängige Kontrollen frei zirkulieren (Art. 16a THG).", "severity": 0.6, "before": "Negativliste (PDF, 193 kB, 01.01.2025)"}]}
